Sonali Bendre Returns for 'Pati Patni Aur Panga' Season 2

Actress Sonali Bendre is returning as the host for the second season of the show 'Pati Patni Aur Panga'. The first season of the show was released in 2023. Bendre also commented on Salman Khan's stance against trolling, stating it has a significant impact.
